name: Karyomegalic Interstitial Nephritis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and clinical diagnostic criteria for Karyomegalic Interstitial Nephritis

criteria.description: Presence of markedly enlarged, hyperchromatic, and irregular nuclei (karyomegaly) in renal tubular epithelial cells on kidney biopsy
Interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy evident on renal biopsy
Progressive chronic kidney disease with proteinuria and impaired renal function
Identification of pathogenic mutations in FAN1 gene supportive but not mandatory
Exclusion of other causes of interstitial nephritis and karyomegaly

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic karyomegaly in renal tubular cells with interstitial fibrosis and clinical evidence of chronic kidney disease
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for FAN1 mutations can confirm diagnosis but is not universally available.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Karyomegaly of renal tubular epithelial cells

searchTerms: edema related to protein in urine

rare.symptomName: Extrarenal karyomegaly in liver or lung tissue
searchTerms: enlarged cell nuclei in liver or lung
large cells in liver or lung tissue

rare.symptomName: Mild anemia secondary to chronic kidney disease
searchTerms: mild low red blood cell count

laboratory: Elevated serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen
imaging: Renal ultrasound showing reduced kidney size and increased echogenicity
other: Kidney biopsy showing karyomegaly and interstitial fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of karyomegaly in tubular epithelial cells
Often associated with drug exposure or autoimmune causes
Generalized proximal tubular dysfunction with glycosuria, aminoaciduria

redFlags: Rapid progression to end-stage renal disease
Presence of markedly enlarged tubular epithelial nuclei on biopsy
Family history of unexplained chronic kidney disease
references: Zhou W et al. Karyomegalic interstitial nephritis: clinical and genetic features. Kidney Int. 2016.
Orphanet Report Series: Karyomegalic interstitial nephritis. Orphanet. 2023.
Lachaud C et al. FAN1 mutations cause karyomegalic interstitial nephritis. Nat Genet. 2016.
